# Digital Culture IT Solutions

> Digital Culture IT Solutions is an independent IT consulting and managed support firm in Bergen County, New Jersey, serving small and medium-sized businesses across North New Jersey and the NYC metro area. Founder-led; specialties are cloud (AWS), infrastructure, storage, migrations, security and day-to-day IT support.

Service area: Bergen, Passaic, Essex, Hudson and Morris counties, NJ (remote support available beyond that).
Contact: (551) 236-4157 | digitalcultureits@gmail.com

## Key pages

- [Home](https://digitalcultureit.com/): Services, pricing tiers (Starter, Business, Business Pro, Pay-As-You-Go), service area, FAQ and contact form
- [Web Portfolio](https://digitalcultureit.com/portfolio.html): Web design and development work for local businesses
- [Projects](https://digitalcultureit.com/projects.html): Open-source and infrastructure/automation projects
- [Security Tools](https://digitalcultureit.com/security-tools.html): Security and hardening tools and write-ups

## Services

- Infrastructure Solutions
- Cloud Services (AWS)
